dedupe_keys.name: macyste port of genoa maritime testbed scenario

description: The MaCySTe authors at the University of Genova publish a virtual maritime scenario covering the Port of Genoa and the Ligurian Sea. They built its three-dimensional environment using heightmap tiles from the Italian National Institute of Geophysics and Volcanology. The MaCySTe repository includes named Genoa scenario and world directories, vessel and environment configuration files, and an OpenCPN chart file. The scenario supplies a concrete port setting for the shipboard cybersecurity testbed, whose simulated navigation and control streams can support monitoring experiments and training. Its spatial coverage is one harbour and nearby waters; run length follows the chosen simulation settings. Documentation and source files are public and free. MaCySTe states AGPL-3.0, while external terrain and other software retain their own terms. A limitation is that the documented virtual scene does not establish a calibrated digital replica of port operations or measured resilience gains. No directly related existing catalogue record was established. Files were identified through metadata only, without downloading terrain, charts or model archives.
licence: AGPL-3.0 for MaCySTe; upstream terrain and third-party component terms apply separately
name: MaCySTe Port of Genoa maritime testbed scenario
notes: G5 G5-0139. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
outcomes: Publishes a port-specific virtual maritime environment for cyber-physical exercises; no measured operational resilience benefit is asserted.
